title: edge scorer: latency + jitter penalty with network-health fusion and model-variant cooldowns
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Design and implement an edge/pop scoring evaluator that combines percentile latency (p50/p95), short-term jitter, and network-quality signals (packet loss, tcp-retries) into a single normalized score used by the region selector. The evaluator must be tier-aware (hosted/dedicated/private) and surface deterministic penalties for tail latency while allowing lightweight, fast failback to pre-approved model variants when a region crosses a degradation threshold.
design_decisions: Use dual-quantile inputs: p50 for steady-state preference, p95 to penalize tail behavior; combine via weighted sum with higher weight on p95 during high-load periods.
Network health is a composite: packet-loss %, median RTT variance (jitter), and connection error rate. Normalize each metric to [0,1] using empirically derived saturations.
Apply asymmetric penalty: tail-latency spikes produce larger instantaneous penalties than similar-magnitude increases in median latency to reduce user-observed tail latency impact.
Smoothing: EWMA with separate alphas for median vs tail signals to avoid over-reacting to single outliers while still being responsive to persistent degradations.

Cooldowns & stickiness: when a region is demoted and a fallback variant is chosen, enforce a configurable cooldown (default 120s) before attempting to re-evaluate to avoid flip-flopping under transient conditions.

Tier awareness: Dedicated pools have lower penalty multipliers for identical telemetry compared to hosted, reflecting SLA commitments and capacity guarantees. Private deployments honor customer-configured thresholds.

Fallthrough policy: if primary model variant is incompatible in fallback region (e.g., missing quantized variant), use nearest compatible variant with a higher cost multiplier documented in routing logs.
Observability: emit per-decision trace with raw signals, normalized scores, final composite score, chosen_region, chosen_variant, and cooldown_expiry timestamp.
API: add an optional 'routing_hint' field on requests to prefer same-region routing when client is colocated; hints are advisory and overridden by safety thresholds.
No change to existing public SDKs; routing logic is server-side. Console adds a new 'Region Score Explorer' and SLO dashboard tile.
scoring_formula: score = base - (w50 * norm(p50)) - (w95 * norm(p95)^gamma) - (wnet * net_penalty) + tier_offset. where net_penalty = max(packet_loss_norm, jitter_norm * jitter_weight, conn_error_norm). Apply EWMA smoothing on each normed input; gamma>1 to amplify tail penalties; tier_offset is negative for dedicated (prefer) and 0 for hosted.
implementation_notes: Create a new evaluator component in routing service: /pkg/routing/evaluator/edge_scorer.go
Add normalization tables and saturations in config service with defaults and per-customer overrides for Private deployments.
Integrate with telemetry pipeline: pull 30s-1m rollups from metrics ingestion; fall back to last-known if telemetry missing for >2mins.
Decision tracing: extend existing tracing envelope with fields: eval_inputs, eval_score_raw, eval_score_norm, chosen_variant, fallback_reason, cooldown_expiry.
Unit tests: synthetic signal generator and property tests for monotonicity (worse signals must not produce better scores), cooldown behavior, and variant compatibility resolution.
Load tests: add a bench harness to simulate 200k decisions/min across 8 regions to validate evaluator latency <1ms p99.
Fail-safes: if telemetry pipeline is degraded, revert to a conservative latency-based routing with increased stickiness and record incident metric.
Config knobs: w50,w95,wnet,gamma,cooldown_secs,tier_offsets; expose in console for runtime tuning behind feature-flag.
Backward compatibility: ensure existing region-ranking fallback still works when evaluator is disabled via feature-flag.
Security: routing hints must be sanitized to avoid path traversal or injection; evaluator runs in control plane with access to telemetry only.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: feature-flag off in staging; run evaluator in dry-run mode emitting traces only (2 weeks)
Phase 1: enable evaluator for 5% of production traffic (canary) with automated rollback if region-fanout increases by >10% or client error rate delta exceeds 0.5pct
Phase 2: 25% traffic with metric observation and 24/7 oncall coverage for 72 hours
Phase 3: 100% traffic but with conservative weights (w95 lowered) for 7 days
Phase 4: enable full weights and expose knobs to SRE/product for fine-tuning
Phase 5: document new dashboards and run a postmortem if any unexpected degradations occur
acceptance_criteria: Region selection decisions must include complete trace fields for 99% of routed requests in canary.
Evaluator p99 decision latency under 1ms under normal load in staging and under bench harness.
Monotonicity tests pass: non-decreasing attack signals never improve region score.
No customer-facing error rate increase in canary (<= 0.1pct delta) and no more than 5% increase in cross-region traffic during canary.
Rollout control knobs function in console and feature-flag toggles immediately halt evaluator behavior.
SRE-approved dashboards show composite score, per-signal contribution, and cooldown events.
Documentation and runbook updated: 'Region Score Explorer' guide, rollback steps, tuning recommendations.
Security review completed for routing_hint and trace emission (audit log entry created).
tests: Unit: normalization edge cases, gamma amplification behavior
Integration: telemetry ingestion -> evaluator pipeline end-to-end with mock metrics
Property: monotonicity and cooldown invariants using QuickCheck-style inputs
Performance: p99 decision latency < 1ms under 200k/min decision load
Chaos: induce packet loss in one region and validate failover to fallback variant within configured cooldown and without infinite flip-flop
dependencies: Infra-ops: permissions to add new control-plane config stores
